description: MassGIS, the Bureau of Geographic Information of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts, keeps the state's catalogue of geographic data layers, each with a description page, metadata and free downloads. The index read on 2026-09-28 groups layers by theme; infrastructure layers include hospitals (added August 2026), dams, fire and police stations, long-term care residences, building structures, aqueducts, water and sewer service areas of the regional water authority, public utility service providers, public water supplies, schools and transmission lines, and transport layers include airports, ferry routes, state roads, MBTA bus, rapid transit and commuter rail, and seaports; physical layers add surficial geology and NEHRP seismic soil classes. A statewide vector package in Shapefile or File Geodatabase format can be requested. Coverage is Massachusetts. Access is free; the index links attribution and citation guidance but states no licence. Caveats: update dates vary by layer, some layers are marked deprecated, and feature-level quality must be checked with the maintainers named on each page. It supports hazard exposure and emergency studies, such as overlaying hospitals, fire stations and water supplies with coastal flood zones in a state model. Related record: HIFLD Open covers similar national layers.
